comments.text: Hi, I’m a nurse. Wanted to chime in about the guy who went missing in police custody. You were asking why they didn’t help him take him to a shelter, etc. Typically shelters fill up very early during the winter. And they also have curfew. So if you don’t make it there by 10 o’clock for example, then you’re not getting in. So if this was at 2 o’clock in the morning, most homeless shelters are not taking people in at that time. As a nurse they very easily could have brought him to any hospital. We would keep them 6 to 8 hours observation. Make sure they sober up safely get hydrated.
